input: nums is a plain dense Array of Number integers in nondecreasing order; target is a Number integer. Preconditions are not checked at runtime.
return: A fresh two-number Array containing the first and last target indices, inclusive; [-1, -1] for an empty Array or absent target. Duplicates are included in the returned range.
mutation_aliasing: No input writes, sorting or copies. The result never aliases nums. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Values and target are safe integers in [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991]; NaN, infinities and BigInt are excluded. Array indices and length are exact Numbers. The midpoint uses Math.floor without bitwise truncation, and no target arithmetic is used.
complexity: O(log(n + 1)) time and O(1) auxiliary space, including the constant-sized fresh result, under constant-cost indexing and Number comparisons.

helpers.name: lowerBound
helpers.contract: Returns the first index whose value is at least target, or n; searches [left, right).
helpers.cost: One call, O(log(n + 1)) time and O(1) space. Its complete identical definition is included in each of the three search candidates.

helpers.name: upperBound
helpers.contract: Returns the first index whose value is greater than target, or n; searches [left, right).
helpers.cost: At most one call, O(log(n + 1)) time and O(1) space; the complete definition is included here.
